# Tax Compliance Automation Skill for Muse

💳 Paid API required — a TaxJar and/or Avalara account is required for automated calculation; automated filing (AutoFile) is a paid plan.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT) by @finsilabs, listed here with credit to its creator. Covers the full multi-jurisdiction e-commerce tax-compliance cycle: nexus-threshold tracking (13,000+ US jurisdictions), real-time checkout tax calculation, B2B exemption-certificate management (Avalara CertCapture / TaxJar Exemptions), automated filing (TaxJar AutoFile, Avalara Managed Returns), and audit-ready reports. Step-by-step setup per platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce) with textual menu walkthroughs, plus TaxJar/Avalara API code for headless shops, and EU VAT (OSS/IOSS) with VIES validation. It explicitly warns never to build your own rate tables and lists the common traps (uncommitted transactions, B2B reverse charge, digital-goods taxability). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: advanced level; the real "automation" (AutoFile) is paid; the JS snippets are illustrative, not turnkey; very US/multi-state e-commerce oriented — less useful outside e-commerce. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
